name: full_algorithm_5
definition: No component removed.

name: without_external_retriever
definition: Remove Algorithm 2 candidate retrieval, including its cleaned-context pass.

name: without_context_cleanup
definition: Suppress the second external search on context-cleaned query text.

name: without_rescue_layer
definition: Remove the complete Algorithm 5 family-rescue result list.

name: without_raw_edit_similarity
definition: Set unweighted normalized edit similarity to zero while retaining distances used by guards.

name: without_weighted_edit_similarity
definition: Set confusion-weighted normalized edit similarity to zero.

name: without_prefix_signal
definition: Set prefix similarity to zero in retrieval, scoring, and corrections.

name: without_suffix_signal
definition: Set suffix similarity to zero in retrieval, scoring, and corrections.

name: without_ngram_signal
definition: Remove character n-gram retrieval and scoring evidence.

name: without_phonetic_signal
definition: Remove the phonetic key from candidate retrieval and scoring.

name: without_skeleton_signal
definition: Remove the consonant-skeleton key from candidate retrieval and scoring.

name: without_subsequence_signal
definition: Set ordered-subsequence similarity to zero.

name: without_positional_signal
definition: Set same-position character evidence to zero.

name: without_length_coverage_signal
definition: Set query-to-family length coverage to zero.

name: without_delete_key_retrieval
definition: Remove deletion-key lookup for full names and family heads.

name: without_short_edge_retrieval
definition: Remove short-query prefix and suffix retrieval.

name: without_confusable_first_character_expansion
definition: Remove first-character confusion expansion and plausibility matching.

name: without_length_bucket_scan
definition: Suppress fallback scanning of compatible-length family buckets.

name: without_variant_head_rescue
definition: Remove matching against validated catalog family heads.

name: without_weighted_confusion_cost
definition: Give every non-identical replacement unit cost.

name: without_retrieval_agreement_bonus
definition: Remove external/context and external/rescue agreement bonuses.

name: without_strict_full_name_correction
definition: Suppress the bounded promotion of a strictly closer rescue-only full name.

name: without_all_reranking
definition: Keep merged score order and remove Algorithm 5 top-rank corrections.

name: without_safety_clarification_gate
definition: Return the same ranking without Algorithm 5 clarification flags.

name: without_short_query_rescue
definition: Disable rescue triggered only because the compact query has three or four characters.

name: without_nearest_fallback
definition: Remove the bounded exhaustive nearest-family fallback.

name: without_evidence_variant_rescue
definition: Remove one-step visual, ligature, stutter, and phonetic query variants.

name: without_short_visible_head_rescue
definition: Remove candidates supported by a short visible catalog-family head.

name: without_short_frame_rescue
definition: Remove short consonant/phonetic frames and two-deletion frame candidates.

name: without_keyboard_variant_rescue
definition: Remove keyboard-neighbor variants and keyboard-plus-deletion chains.

name: without_ligature_variant_rescue
definition: Remove direct ligature variants and ligature-plus-vowel/transposition chains.

name: without_transposition_variant_rescue
definition: Remove adjacent-transposition variants and transposition-plus-deletion chains.

name: without_visual_phonetic_chain_rescue
definition: Remove exact candidates requiring a visual replacement followed by a phonetic replacement.

name: without_visual_deletion_chain_rescue
definition: Remove exact candidates requiring visual confusions plus a missing character.

name: without_all_multi_step_chain_rescue
definition: Remove every Algorithm 5 multi-operation variant and exact-chain retrieval path.

name: without_exact_chain_score_augmentation
definition: Do not raise an existing candidate score from exact multi-step-chain evidence.

name: without_nearest_rerankers
definition: Disable all bounded-nearest promotion variants after initial ranking.

name: without_weighted_edge_rerankers
definition: Disable weighted-distance and prefix/suffix tie corrections.

name: without_exact_key_rerankers
definition: Disable exact transformed-key corrections for ligatures, transpositions, keyboard errors, and phonetics.

name: without_chain_rerankers
definition: Disable every exact-chain promotion after candidate retrieval.

name: without_character_evidence_rerankers
definition: Disable Pareto, positional, visual, skeleton, shifted-edge, and two-sided-anchor corrections.

name: without_candidate_pool_head_rerankers
definition: Disable validated-head, short-visible-head, ordered-head, and candidate-pool head corrections.

name: without_in_place_chain_score_tuning
definition: Keep chain retrieval but prevent it from replacing an existing candidate score.
